scope: Complete three-page DatesTutorial: all 36 native TMP memberships, six full wording units. Russian owner-reported display repair, no global source/release gate waiver.

coverage.note: Three identical title texts are three assigned page-role units; there are four distinct text pairs, six page-role units, and 36 native TMP memberships. All were read, including each repeated native row; no sampling or generated default-pass rows.

units.assessment: The full critter-date title is preserved in natural Russian word order. Both size=22 spans cover the initial letter of a corresponding target word; fixed markup and ornamental uppercase text remain unchanged.

units.source: The Critters of the area are inspired by your promiscuity! Occasionally, critters will show up in pairs by Maverick’s Shop and be hanging out! Be sure to talk with them and see how they are doing!
units.target: Зверушек вдохновили твои любовные похождения! Иногда у магазина Маверика можно встретить парочки. Поговори с ними и узнай, как у них дела!
units.assessment: «любовные похождения» retains the adult/flirtatious multiple-romance implication of promiscuity without adding explicit acts. Inspiration/agency, occasional pair appearance by Maverick’s shop, and invitation to talk/check how they are doing are retained. «парочки» naturally conveys pairs spending time together. Local ambient critters remain clear in scene context. No obligatory dating or gender invention.
Same full critter-date heading as Page1, independently checked in Page2 context and across its six native TMP memberships. No temporal/calendar reading or mandatory-date claim introduced.

units.source: Dates are unlocked over time. Some may require certain quests or gossips to unlock. Some dates will continue over multiple meets!
units.target: Свидания открываются со временем. Для некоторых нужно выполнить задания или услышать определённые слухи. Некоторые истории продолжаются на следующих встречах!
units.assessment: Time unlocks and continuation across subsequent meetings are faithful; «истории» is licensed by glossary tfol-058. Required corrections are fully consolidated in RU-DATES-01.
Same full critter-date heading as Pages1–2, independently checked in Page3 context and across its six native TMP memberships. Markup and glossary concepts are retained.

units.source: When critters are “on a date” – They won’t be able to do Quests, OR gossips. You will need to locate them in their normal locations for that. Besides… it would be quite rude to bother them during their date!
units.target: Во время свидания зверушки не дают заданий и не делятся слухами. Для этого ищи их в обычных местах. Да и мешать им на свидании было бы невежливо!
units.assessment: The temporary date context, normal-location instruction, and polite noninterruption warning are faithful. Required gameplay-term/quest-scope corrections are fully consolidated in RU-DATES-02.

findings.reason: The approved glossary tfol-055 names Gossip as the conversation system «Беседы», not rumors. «услышать определённые слухи» changes a system interaction into hearing rumors. Source «certain quests or gossips» also requires specific quests, but target «выполнить задания» drops that restriction.

findings.proposedTarget: Свидания открываются со временем. Для некоторых нужно выполнить определённые задания или провести определённые беседы. Некоторые истории продолжаются на следующих встречах!
preservedFacts: Some require particular quests or conversations
Some date stories continue over multiple meetings

findings.reason: «не делятся слухами» substitutes rumors for glossary tfol-055 «Беседы». «не дают заданий» narrows the source’s temporary inability to do quest interactions to giving quests alone. State general quest/conversation unavailability while on a date, then the normal-location instruction and politeness warning.
